mobile-w4-f32-diagnostic-20261022.route: Python Core AI fixed-input comparisons and partial free rollout versus the independent same-weight source reference B on MPS

workload.en: Frozen 60-run suite, 8 steps. Source B completed all 60 runs and both required repeats with zero repeat difference. Core AI fixed comparisons: 32 of 1,230 failed at the full valid joint (e08/e09 for run suffixes 20261018 and 20261021, all 8 steps); all 480 target-region comparisons passed. Free rollout stopped after 16 of 60 runs. The JSON has no exported-asset inventory hash; power/thermal were not captured; no latency claim.
workload.ja: 凍結60run suite、8step。原典Bは全60runと必須2反復を完了し、反復差は0。Core AIの固定比較は1,230件中32件がfull valid jointで不合格（e08/e09の20261018・20261021、各8step）、target領域480件は全合格。自由rolloutは60run中16runで中止。JSONに書出し資産のinventory hashはなく、電源/熱は未記録で速度の主張には使わない。

mobile-selective-dit-20261022.route: Python Core AI DiT fixed-input calls versus the independent same-weight source replay on MPS

workload.en: Four fixed DiT step0 inputs (g01/e01/e08/e09, 20261018) reused from the W4/F32 cohort. w4-blocks16-23-f32 keeps F16 Linear weights in zero-based DiT blocks 16–23 and passed full-joint and target gates for 4/4 inputs; w4-blocks20-21-f32 failed full-joint for 2/4 (e08/e09). Artifact revision is the 8-block DiT main.mlirb SHA-256; other asset hashes are in the JSON. Not the 60-run suite, rollout, quality or device result; verified=false; power/thermal were not captured; no latency claim.
workload.ja: W4/F32 cohortの固定DiT step0入力4件（g01/e01/e08/e09、20261018）を再利用。0始まりのDiT block16〜23のLinear weightをF16で保持するw4-blocks16-23-f32はfull-joint/targetとも4/4合格、w4-blocks20-21-f32はfull-jointで2/4（e08/e09）不合格。資産revisionは8block DiTのmain.mlirbのSHA-256で、他の資産hashはJSONにある。60run suite・rollout・品質・実機の結果ではなくverified=false。電源/熱は未記録で速度の主張には使わない。

note.en: No mobile candidate has passed. The W4/F16 DiT failed fixed-input gates (2 inputs × 8 steps). The all-component W4/F32 candidate failed 32 of 1,230 fixed comparisons at the full valid joint, while all 480 target-region comparisons passed. The 8-block retained-weight DiT passed four fixed step0 inputs, but the 60-run suite, rollout, quality and device checks are not done. The earlier FP32 pass remains in its own evidence.
note.ja: モバイル候補は未合格。W4/F16 DiTは固定入力（2入力×8step）で不合格。全部品のW4/F32は固定比較1,230件中32件がfull valid jointで不合格（target領域480件は合格）。8block保持DiTは固定step0の4入力で合格したが、60run suite・rollout・品質・実機は未実施。従来FP32の合格は別の証拠として保持する。
